prerequisites: Having successfully completed the first-year courses in Algebra and Calculus
Real numbers: Intervals, neighborhoods, accumulation or limit points. Bounded sets, supremum and infimum of a bounded set. Sequences and series of real numbers
Real functions of a real variable: Limits and continuity
Differentiation: Elementary properties. Chain rule. Successive derivatives. Taylor's Theorem. Applications
Integration: Definition of the Riemann integral. Properties. Fundamental theorems of integral calculus. Integration methods. Applications of the integral
The space R^n: Distance and norm. Bounded sets. Neighborhoods. Open and closed sets. Adherence and accumulation
The space R^3: Orthogonality. Scalar product
Functions of several variables: Limits and continuity. Differentiability, properties and applications. Inverse and implicit functions
syllabus_topics: Review of notations and basic mathematical concepts
Review of elementary concepts of infinitesimal calculus (functions, limits, derivatives, integrals, series, etc.)
Review elements of linear and multilinear algebra (vector spaces, linear applications, determinants, etc.)
Differential of a form: gradient, divergence and curl
Calculation of k-dimensional volumes of not necessarily linear manifolds
Definition of the field C and its properties
Fundamental functions of complex variable calculus
Integral of a complex function over a closed curve
teaching_methods: Specially prepared didactic materials (theory manual with examples and questionnaires, solved exercises in written and video format)
Virtual course forums for raising doubts
Associated center tutorials (synchronous classes for doubt resolution or content summaries)
assessment_rules: The final grade is obtained by summing the score of the presential exam (x, between 0 and 10) and the points from the Continuous Assessment Tests (y, between 0 and 1.5), provided the exam score is 3.5 or higher. If the exam score is below 3.5, the final grade is simply the exam score. A minimum final grade of 5.0 is required to pass the course. The presential exam can be taken in the February or September calls. Not presenting for the final exam results in a 'No Presentado' grade.
